operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 Glass Lined Products segment revenue was ₹219.54 Cr with PBIT of ₹14.70 Cr, against ₹167.87 Cr and ₹18.15 Cr a year ago.
FY26 exceptional items of ₹6.69 Cr comprised ₹4.62 Cr business-acquisition transaction cost and ₹2.07 Cr past-service defined benefit obligation.
The company incorporated HLE International S.a.r.l. in Luxembourg as a wholly owned subsidiary during the quarter.

timeline.summary: HLE Glascoat Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 1.10 per equity share (55% of Rs. 2 each) for FY2025-26, pending shareholder approval at the AGM.
HLE Glascoat reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,353 Cr and PAT of ₹56.6 Cr with an order book of ₹681.6 Cr.
HLE Glascoat Limited’s **Achal S. Thakkar** shared the Q4 FY26 earnings call recording (25/05/2026) on the company’s website.
HLE Glascoat's Q4FY26 earnings call (25 May 2026) set a ₹2,000 Cr revenue vision in about two years and a 14-15% consolidated EBITDA margin target, with Omeras near breakeven.

status_history.evidence: FY26 EBITDA margin was 11%; adjusted for Omeras about 13.5%, with 14-15% guided for FY27.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval of ₹1.10 per share dividend at the AGM

watchlist.response: CFO said the 16% referred to H2 and next year, and adjusted for Omeras the ongoing business is about 13.5%.
watchlist.text: FY26 EBITDA margin of 11% missed the 16% guided on the Q2 call.

watchlist.response: Harsh Patel said equipment volumes dispatched rose 30-40% but value per equipment fell, so revenue did not grow.
watchlist.text: India glass-lined revenue has been flat for four years.
